```{r}
export_gene_detection <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    cell_type,
    genes,
    output_file,
    cell_type_column = "cell_type",
    assay = "XeniumClean"
) {
  
  meta <- seurat_obj[[]]
  
  cells <- rownames(meta)[
    !is.na(meta[[cell_type_column]]) &
    meta[[cell_type_column]] == cell_type
  ]
  
  counts <- GetAssayData(
    seurat_obj,
    assay = assay,
    layer = "counts"
  )[, cells, drop = FALSE]
  
  panel_genes <- intersect(
    genes,
    rownames(counts)
  )
  
  counts <- counts[
    panel_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  detected_cells <- Matrix::rowSums(counts > 0)
  total_cells <- ncol(counts)
  
  results <- data.frame(
    Cell_Type = cell_type,
    Gene = names(detected_cells),
    Detected_Cells = as.integer(detected_cells),
    Total_Cells = total_cells,
    Detection_Frequency =
      as.numeric(detected_cells) / total_cells,
    Detection_Percent =
      as.numeric(detected_cells) / total_cells * 100
  )
  
  results$Category <- dplyr::case_when(
    results$Detection_Frequency >= 0.10 ~ "Expressed",
    results$Detection_Frequency < 0.05 ~ "Not-expressed",
    TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
  )
  
  results <- results[
    order(-results$Detection_Frequency),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  write.csv(
    results,
    output_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  results
}
```

```{r}
dir.create(
  "Clean_Xen1_gene_detection_fine_celltypes",
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

cell_types <- sort(
  unique(xenium_clean$cell_type)
)

for (ct in cell_types) {
  
  if (is.na(ct)) next
  
  message(
    "Processing ", ct,
    ": ",
    sum(xenium_clean$cell_type == ct, na.rm = TRUE),
    " cells"
  )
  
  safe_name <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9_]+",
    "_",
    ct
  )
  
  export_gene_detection(
    seurat_obj = xenium_clean,
    cell_type = ct,
    xenium_genes = xenium_genes,
    output_file = file.path(
  "results/Xenium_clean/gene_detection_fine_celltypes",
  paste0(safe_name, "_gene_detection.csv")
    ), 
    cell_type_column = "cell_type",
    assay = "XeniumClean"
  )
}
```

# Genes in scRNA-seq reference
scRNA_genes <- rownames(reference[["RNA"]])

# Original Xenium gene panel
xenium_genes <- rownames(xenium_clean[["Xenium"]])

# Genes shared between scRNA-seq and Xenium
shared_genes <- intersect(
  scRNA_genes,
  xenium_genes
)

length(shared_genes)

)

# ScRNAseq broad
```{r}
reference <- JoinLayers(
  reference,
  assay = "RNA"
)

# Get counts from the scRNA-seq reference
reference_counts <- GetAssayData(
  reference,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "counts"
)

# Get data from the scRNA-seq reference
reference_data <- GetAssayData(
  reference,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)

# Output directory
dir.create(
  "results/scRNAseq/gene_detection_shared/broad",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Broad cell types
broad_types <- sort(
  unique(reference$scRNAseq_broad_type)
)

# Run detection analysis
for (bt in broad_types) {
  
  if (is.na(bt)) next
  
  message(
    "Processing ", bt, ": ",
    sum(reference$scRNAseq_broad_type == bt, na.rm = TRUE),
    " cells"
  )
  
  cells <- rownames(reference[[]])[
    reference$scRNAseq_broad_type == bt
  ]
  
  # Make sure cells exist in the counts matrix
  cells <- intersect(
    cells,
    colnames(reference_counts)
  )
  
  # Keep only the shared Xenium/scRNA-seq genes
  genes <- intersect(
    shared_genes,
    rownames(reference_counts)
  )
  
  message("Cells retained: ", length(cells))
  message("Shared genes: ", length(genes))
  
  if (length(cells) == 0 || length(genes) == 0) {
    warning("Skipping ", bt)
    next
  }
  
  counts <- reference_counts[
    genes,
    cells,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Number of cells in which each gene is detected
  detected_cells <- Matrix::rowSums(counts > 0)
  total_cells <- ncol(counts)
  
  # Mean raw count
  mean_raw_count <- Matrix::rowMeans(counts)
  
  # Average normalised expression
  expression <- reference_data[
    genes,
    cells,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  average_expression <- Matrix::rowMeans(expression)
  
  message(
  "BT = ", bt,
  " | metadata cells = ", length(cells),
  " | matrix cells = ", ncol(counts),
  " | max detected = ", max(detected_cells)
)
  
  results <- data.frame(
    Broad_Type = bt,
    Gene = names(detected_cells),
    Detected_Cells = as.integer(detected_cells),
    Total_Cells = total_cells,
    Detection_Frequency =
      as.numeric(detected_cells) / total_cells,
    Detection_Percent =
      as.numeric(detected_cells) / total_cells * 100,
    Mean_Raw_Count =
    as.numeric(mean_raw_count),
    Average_Expression = 
      as.numeric(average_expression)
  )
  
  # Categorise genes using the XeniumClean thresholds
  results$Category <- dplyr::case_when(
    results$Detection_Frequency >= 0.10 ~ "Expressed",
    results$Detection_Frequency < 0.05 ~ "Not Expressed",
    TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
  )
  
  # Sort by detection frequency
  results <- results[
    order(-results$Detection_Frequency),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Safe filename
  safe_name <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9_]+",
    "_",
    bt
  )
  
  # Save
  write.csv(
    results,
    file.path(
      "results/Xenium_clean/Xen1_scRNA-seq_gene_detection_broad_celltypes",
      paste0(
        "Xen1_scRNA-seq_",
        safe_name,
        "_gene_detection.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```
